title: New listing The Crow's Nest at Turtle Bay Marina
description:
Welcome to The Crow’s Nest & Turtle Bay…

This is a brand new construction home as of 2022 and is one of the newer additions to our collection. Please be sure to see the 1000’s of reviews on our other properties.

This stunning waterfront development overlooks Old Hickory Lake and Turtle Bay Marina.
Enjoy an evening beer or glass of wine on the crow’s nest rooftop soaking in the sunset over the water and then head into downtown Nashville and be on broadway in under 30 mins in an Uber!

The space
This 4 bedroom, 3 bathroom townhome features not only a spacious rooftop, but multiple balconies and a covered front porch to take in the outdoors. There is a fully equipped kitchen with barstools that flows openly into the living room where a flat screen Smart TV is mounted on the wall.
A short 1 minute walk will have you sitting at the Marina Bar & Restaurant enjoying a wonderful ‘lake life’ setting in one of Nashville’s waterfront favorite hang outs. Live music is performed on most days and the atmosphere is truly Nashville. Boat rentals and other waterfront activities are available at the Marina.

Other amenities such as grocery stores and multiple golf courses are located just minutes away including 2 public championship quality courses located at The Hermitage.

The sleeping arrangements in the home are as follows:

Bedroom #1 - King Bed with en-suite bathroom. TV

Bedroom #2 - Queen Bed with en-suite bathroom. TV

Bedroom #3 - Queen Bed. TV

Bedroom #4 - Full Sized Bunk Beds. TV

Living Room - Sleeper Sofa. TV

There is a moderately sized 2 car garage that will accommodate 2 smaller vehicles (not large trucks) and beyond that, public parking will need to be found along adjacent streets and could involve a short walk.

We can’t wait to host you for your trip to Nashville and you'll come back again and again.
